Alpha 5: Lounge is now a native app, drawn with Slint instead of a web view.

- Every screen has been rebuilt natively: Home, the libraries, game, movie and show pages, Search, Settings, Stats, Transfers, the remote browser, Apps, the controller tester, the quick menu, now playing and updates.
- One self-contained Lounge.exe: no WebView2 and no web runtime underneath.
- Lower memory use: decoded artwork is capped at 96 MB.
- Untested on a real handheld so far — please report anything that looks or feels off next to 2.2.0.
- Known gaps: no blur effects, some entrance animations missing, no Legion Go controller battery line in the quick menu yet.
